title: Full Functional Restoration — Quantumoney Core Rebuild

requirements.text: Remove all animated coin visuals, 3D decorative elements (including FloatingQMYCoins, SpaceBackground, QuantumUniverseScene, and any Three.js/React Three Fiber components), and unnecessary visual overlays from all pages. The UI must be static — no animations until the system is fully functional.

quotes: Remover todas as imagens animadas de moedas.
Nada animado até o sistema funcionar.

acceptanceCriteria: No animated coin images appear on any page
No Three.js / React Three Fiber components render
SpaceBackground is removed from Layout
Pages load without any CSS or JS animation classes on decorative elements

requirements.text: Fix all page titles where the string 'nav.' appears as a prefix (e.g., 'nav.map', 'nav.profile') — replace them with clean, human-readable English/Portuguese titles.

quotes: Corrigir títulos onde aparece 'nav.' antes do texto.

acceptanceCriteria: No visible heading or tab label contains the prefix 'nav.'
All page titles render as readable text

requirements.text: Restore a fixed footer across all pages displaying exactly: '© 2026 Quantumoney. All rights reserved.' and 'By HTgamers'. Remove any reference to 'Caffeine' from the footer and from all user-facing page content.

quotes: Restaurar rodapé fixo com: © 2026 Quantumoney. Todos os direitos reservados. By HTgamers
Nenhuma referência a Caffeine em rodapés ou código.

acceptanceCriteria: Footer is fixed at the bottom on all pages
Footer text reads '© 2026 Quantumoney. All rights reserved.' and 'By HTgamers'
No page or footer contains the word 'Caffeine'

requirements.text: Enforce a clean, simple dark layout with yellow/gold accent details across the entire app. No gradients, no glow effects, no decorative overlays. Typography must be readable. This is the baseline visual style until the system is stable.

quotes: Layout deve ser simples, limpo, escuro com detalhes amarelos.

acceptanceCriteria: All pages use a dark background (#0a0a0a or equivalent)
Accent color is yellow/gold throughout
No animated or 3D background is present
UI is legible and consistent across all routes

requirements.text: Restore Internet Identity login as the sole authentication method. Login must work end-to-end: clicking login opens the Internet Identity flow, and on success the user's Principal is available throughout the app via AuthContext.
acceptanceCriteria: Login button triggers Internet Identity authentication popup
After successful login, the user's Principal ID is accessible in AuthContext
Logout clears the session
Unauthenticated users are redirected or shown a login prompt on protected pages

requirements.text: Restore the /profile page to display: the user's Principal ID, QMY balance (fetched from Ledger canister 5o54h-giaaa-aaaad-aentq-cai), ICP balance, and current XP. If any balance is unavailable or zero, display 0 — never hide the wallet section.

quotes: Ao entrar em /profile deve mostrar: Principal, Saldo QMY, Saldo ICP, XP atual
Se saldo não existir, mostrar 0 — não esconder a carteira.

acceptanceCriteria: /profile shows Principal ID for authenticated users
QMY balance is fetched from canister 5o54h-giaaa-aaaad-aentq-cai and displayed
ICP balance is displayed
XP is displayed
All values show '0' if the balance fetch returns empty or zero — the wallet section is always visible

requirements.text: Restore the backend actor to store a per-user `welcomeBonusGranted` flag. On the first real login (authenticated Principal not previously seen), grant +1000 QMY and +100 XP. Set the flag so the bonus is never granted again to the same Principal.

quotes: No primeiro login real: +1000 QMY, +100 XP

acceptanceCriteria: Backend has a `claimWelcomeBonus` or equivalent endpoint
Calling it for the first time for a Principal adds +1000 QMY and +100 XP to their profile
Subsequent calls return an error or no-op without granting additional tokens
The flag persists across canister upgrades via stable storage

requirements.text: On the frontend, after a successful first login, call the welcome bonus endpoint and display a banner/modal showing '+1000 QMY and +100 XP received'. This should only appear once per user.
acceptanceCriteria: Welcome bonus banner/modal appears on first login
It shows +1000 QMY and +100 XP
It does not appear on subsequent logins
It can be dismissed by the user

requirements.text: Restore the backend to store and serve geographically distributed QMY coin locations. Initialize 600,000,000 QMY distributed across real-world geographic clusters (based on Gold Paper regional rules: major population centers across continents). Each coin cluster must have lat/lon coordinates, a QMY amount, and an ID. Expose a query endpoint to fetch all active coin locations.
acceptanceCriteria: Backend stores at least 50 coin cluster locations with lat/lon/amount/id
Total QMY distributed across all clusters sums to 600,000,000
A query endpoint returns all active coin locations
Data is in stable storage and survives upgrades

requirements.text: Restore the /map page with a fully functional Leaflet + OpenStreetMap 2D map. Fetch coin locations from the backend and display them as markers on the map with real geographic coordinates. The map must load without errors.

quotes: Sem mapa → o jogo não existe.

acceptanceCriteria: Leaflet map renders on /map
OpenStreetMap tiles load
Coin markers appear at their real-world coordinates
Map loads without console errors

requirements.text: Implement the basic coin capture mechanic on the map: when the user clicks a coin marker, check if the user's device location is within 50 meters. If yes, call the backend to capture the coin, award XP proportional to the distance traveled since the last capture, and update the user's QMY balance. If the user is more than 50m away, show an error message.

quotes: Pode clicar e capturar se estiver a menos de 50m
Recebe XP proporcional à distância percorrida

acceptanceCriteria: Clicking a coin marker within 50m triggers a capture call to the backend
QMY balance increases after a successful capture
XP increases proportionally to distance
Clicking a marker more than 50m away shows 'Too far to capture' message
Captured coins are removed or marked as taken on the map

requirements.text: Restore a basic XP system in the backend: each player profile stores a total XP value. Provide endpoints to add XP (used by coin capture and welcome bonus). XP must persist in stable storage.
acceptanceCriteria: Player profiles include an `xp` field
XP is incremented correctly via capture and bonus endpoints
XP persists across sessions and canister upgrades

requirements.text: Temporarily disable or hide the following features from the UI and routing: Advanced Central Bank dashboard, DAO voting and proposals, complex vesting schedules, public token burns, and all charts/graphs. These routes should either show a 'Coming Soon' placeholder or be removed from navigation entirely.

quotes: Desativar temporariamente: Banco Central avançado, DAO, Vesting complexo, Queimas públicas, Gráficos

acceptanceCriteria: DAO pages are not accessible from main navigation
Central Bank advanced page is not accessible from main navigation
Complex vesting pages are not accessible from main navigation
Public burn pages are not accessible from main navigation
Chart components are not rendered on any active page
Bottom navigation only shows: Home, Map, Profile

requirements.text: Simplify the bottom navigation bar to show only the core active tabs: Home, Map, and Profile. Remove tabs for DAO, Banco (Central Bank), AR, and Chat until those features are restored.
acceptanceCriteria: Bottom nav has exactly 3 tabs: Home, Map, Profile
Removed tabs do not appear
Active tab is highlighted in yellow/gold

requirements.text: Restore a basic transaction history display on /profile showing the user's recent QMY coin captures (date, amount received, XP gained). If no history exists, show an empty state message — never hide the section.
acceptanceCriteria: Transaction/capture history section is visible on /profile
Each entry shows date, QMY received, and XP gained
Empty state message is shown when no history exists

constraints: QMY Ledger canister ID must be exactly: 5o54h-giaaa-aaaad-aentq-cai — do not change or hardcode a different value
No reference to 'Caffeine' in any user-facing text, footer, or visible code comments
Do not implement AR features — 2D Leaflet map only
No animations or 3D components until core functionality is verified working
All Motoko logic must remain in a single main actor (backend/main.mo)
Do not modify files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, useActor.ts, main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui
nonGoals: Visual design improvements beyond the dark/yellow baseline
